methodology: Unchanged 24 fixtures. Release builds. Fresh processes/profiles, no learning. Neural settings are recorded per engine; no external context or personalization. Composition and neural session caches reset before each phrase. One cold request then one full warmup pass, followed by 20 passes alternating engine order. Then five fresh-process startup trials per engine, alternating order, with OS file caches warm. Sequential subprocess calls, no HTTP. Whole-sentence rankings for AzooKey only; Mozc alternatives are per segment. Valid spelling variants count as misses. Internal timers have slightly different boundaries; subprocess round trips include serialization and reset for both.
